package delivery

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"modernc.org/sqlite"
)

// Retained diagnostic only: reproduce contention without a timer releasing
// the first raw transaction before the driver's fixed busy timeout.
func TestSelectionHeldRawWriterProbe(t *testing.T) {
	db, a, _ := selectionWriterFixture(t, "sqlite")
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	id, fact := uuid.NewString(), selectionFact(t, "held-first")
	first, err := db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer first.Rollback()
	if err := a.persistHandlerRuleSelectionSQL(ctx, first, id, fact); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		contender, err := db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
		if err != nil {
			done <- err
			return
		}
		defer contender.Rollback()
		done <- a.persistHandlerRuleSelectionSQL(ctx, contender, id, fact)
	}()
	select {
	case err := <-done:
		var native *sqlite.Error
		if !errors.As(err, &native) || native.Code()&255 != 5 {
			t.Fatalf("expected native contention before first commit: %v", err)
		}
		t.Logf("first raw writer still held; contender returned %v", err)
	case <-ctx.Done():
		t.Fatal(ctx.Err())
	}
	if err := first.Commit(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var count int
	if err := db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM event_delivery_handler_rule_selections WHERE delivery_id=$1`, id).Scan(&count); err != nil || count != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("first canonical fact count=%d err=%v", count, err)
	}
}
